description: 80-dps parameter-free verification of SecondOrderGPMTCabledAlphaAndCarbon12.lean (Bean qou-ozdk): complete H_{4k}(q) (k = 1..5, A = 4..20) Pauli-allowed (ell <= 4) Convention-D zero-multiplicity census (m <= 2 cap), SU(4) Wigner-singlet uniqueness of (k^4), exact telescoping second-order GPMT formula d_mod^{(2)}(k^4; q), cabled inter-alpha twist factorization 2*c(k^4) - k*2*c(1^4) = 8*C(k,2), and side-by-side multi-alpha binding audit across 4He, 8Be, 12C, 16O, and 20Ne.
caveats: Exact H_{4k}(q) GPMT stratification vs global trace scaling: Part 1 verifies across all 226 Pauli-allowed (ell <= 4) partitions of A = 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 that Convention-D zero multiplicity satisfies m(lambda) <= 2 universally (0 shapes have m >= 3), that (k^4) is the unique SU(4) spin-isospin singlet at A = 4k with m(k^4) = 2 for all k >= 2, and that its second-order GPMT dimension telescopes to -[3]_q![2]_q![k-1]_q![k-2]_q! / ([k+3]_q![k+2]_q!). Evaluated directly as an un-localized global A-strand trace, f^{(k^4)} |d_mod^{(2)}(k^4; q)| * E_0^(tower) gives 0.2205 MeV (8Be), 0.4388 MeV (12C), and 2.8673 MeV (16O) while f^{(k^4)} |w^{(2)}_{(k^4)}| * E_0^(tower) decays as [2]_q^{4-4k}, confirming that physical nuclear binding is extensive/simplicial rather than a single global A-strand Markov functional.

Sign of cabled twist 8*C(k,2) and candid inter-alpha comparison (zero fitting): (1) In S^{(k^4)}, internal alpha attraction comes from negative column content 2*c(1^4) = -12 < 0, whereas 2*c(k^4) - k*2*c(1^4) = +8*C(k,2) > 0 has the opposite sign — representing Pauli antisymmetrization / harmonic-oscillator shell promotion across columns (-6, -2, +2, +6, +10), so treating +8*C(k,2) naively as attractive crossings (Model C1) severely overbinds 8Be (+14.44 MeV vs -0.092 MeV AME). (2) A single inter-alpha Convention-D bond b2_logD per cluster edge leaves 8Be properly unbound (-0.0760 MeV at bare E_0, -0.0557 MeV at tower E_0 vs -0.0918 MeV AME). (3) Across cluster-simplex Borromean 3-alpha triad candidates at q_2t (all keeping 8Be at -0.0557 MeV unbound), unscaled 1*w3 underbinds Delta_B(12C) (+1.21 vs +7.27 MeV), [3]_q^2 * w3 = (E_0 * [3]_q / [2]_q) gives Delta_B(12C) = +6.914 MeV (-4.96%) and Delta_B(16O) = +14.723 MeV (+1.98% vs +14.437 MeV AME; total B: -5.60% on 12C, -4.79% on 16O), and 12*w3 (unoriented distinct spin-isospin flavor triples) gives total B 88.89 MeV (-3.55%) on 12C, 125.28 MeV (-1.83%) on 16O, and 160.57 MeV (-0.05%) on 20Ne; deriving the exact coarse-grained 3-alpha triad coefficient from H_{12}(q) projector contraction remains open.
